Jordan Reed: Heads-up — product just pinged about several project tiles showing "$0.00" during yesterday's rollout.
Asha Kapoor: Oof. Which tiles?
Jordan Reed: The per-model heatmap and the per-route marginal-cost cards. Tokens show up elsewhere but cost cells are empty/zero.
Nate O'Neal: Same pattern we saw before: ingest flags prefetch_replay and we null out unit_cost to avoid double counting. That results in SUM(tokens * unit_cost) == 0.
Asha Kapoor: Hiding cost is worse than showing an estimate. Users want to see gross vs net.
Jordan Reed: Proposal: emit new fields in econ_event v2: route_variant, effective_model_sku, amortized_unit_cost, credit_reason, sampling_rate, sample_count.
Nate O'Neal: Implementation: ingest computes amortized_unit_cost when prefetch occurs and sets credit_reason to "prefetch_hit"/"prefetch_replay"/"router_fallback". Keep unit_cost for backcompat.
Asha Kapoor: Dashboard defaults to net (post-credit) but show a faint dotted gross overlay and an explicit "Show gross costs" toggle. Hover should surface sample_count + sampling_rate and a breakdown by credit_reason.
Jordan Reed: Also add a low-sample indicator when sample_count < 50: show "Estimate noisy: low sample (N)" and dim the sparkline.
Nate O'Neal: SQL sketch: SELECT route, route_variant, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(amortized_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS net_cost, SUM(tokens * unit_cost) AS gross_cost, AVG(sampling_rate) AS sampling_rate, SUM(sample_count) AS sample_count FROM econ_events WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY route, route_variant;
Asha Kapoor: Ops: feature-flag `econ_amortize_v2` so dashboards can opt-in. Need canary windows after proto PR.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: Retention override applied: econ-raw-events = 30d for rollout. Canary job queued: cost-ingest-v2 -> canary-01 (flag: econ_amortize_v2).
Jordan Reed: Action items: Nate -> proto + ingest change + migration notes; Asha -> dashboard query + toggle + hover copy + mockups; Jordan -> reconciliation job to diff old vs new aggregates.
Nate O'Neal: I'll open the PR with fields and include amortization formula and minimal audit fields (warmup_cost_usd, expected_uses, expected_tokens).
Asha Kapoor: I'll wire the toggle and add the low-sample UX. We'll keep default net but surface gross prominently for debugging.
Jordan Reed: Good. Let's avoid another wave of support tickets complaining "where did my cost go".
Asha Kapoor: Agreed. Posting mockups and PR links when ready.
metrics-bot: metrics-bot: Canary scheduled for 2024-08-20T02:00Z.
